# Build the pinned upstream release with KissFFT and let the media core
# perform resampling. Keep the library separately replaceable.
set(ARCHIVE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/chromaprint-1.6.2.tar.gz")
set(CHROMAPRINT_SHA256 d54ada62c16b2db396d3251ec54fc7a58909c163131a1cfcf7fa6407dbc14360)
file(SHA256 "${ARCHIVE}" ACTUAL)
if(NOT ACTUAL STREQUAL CHROMAPRINT_SHA256)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected Chromaprint source SHA-256")
endif()
set(SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/source")
if(NOT EXISTS "${SOURCE_DIR}/${CHROMAPRINT_SHA256}")
  file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${SOURCE_DIR}")
  file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT INPUT "${ARCHIVE}" DESTINATION "${SOURCE_DIR}")
  file(TOUCH "${SOURCE_DIR}/${CHROMAPRINT_SHA256}")
endif()
set(UPSTREAM "${SOURCE_DIR}/chromaprint-1.6.2")
set(FFT_LIB kissfft CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
set(KISSFFT_SOURCE_DIR "${UPSTREAM}/src/3rdparty/kissfft" CACHE PATH "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(USE_INTERNAL_AVRESAMPLE OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CMAKE_DISABLE_FIND_PACKAGE_FFmpeg TRUE)
add_subdirectory("${UPSTREAM}" upstream EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
if(ANDROID)
  # The package installer needs the unversioned .so and its matching SONAME.
  set_target_properties(chromaprint PROPERTIES NO_SONAME FALSE)
  set_property(TARGET chromaprint PROPERTY VERSION "")
  set_property(TARGET chromaprint PROPERTY SOVERSION "")
  target_link_options(chromaprint PRIVATE "-Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384" "-Wl,-z,common-page-size=16384")
endif()
target_include_directories(chromaprint INTERFACE "$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${UPSTREAM}/src>")
